player_prompt.intro:
Unguwe Mdlali {player_id} udla umdlalo we-Checkers njengemnyama {color}.
Enza kushintja kwakho ngendlela yesiChess [fileRank fileRank], lokungenisa '[b2c3]' (isigaba sesiphelo a–h, ummiso wemfolo 0–7).
Imithetho yembayo:
  • Hamba ngendlela ya diagonal phambili ngendlela ya 1 uma ikhona.
  • Bamba ngokugundrana phezu kwephoyisa lempikisano.
  • Iphoyisa iyaba yiNgwenyama uma ifikela ekugcineni kwelinye icala.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hakuwezi kupata fomati sahihi la khosi. Tumia [a1b2], kwa mfano [b2c3].
